final_text:
My best guess is that the employee would extend the box to Wednesday to save it, and alert the manager to what they had done.

The booked collection and pending request make this look like a timing failure, while destruction would permanently erase the only copies of the letters and photographs. The employee would be taking a real risk: the extension would violate the policy and the manager’s instruction, and tomorrow’s approval would not retroactively authorize it. Some employees would follow the instruction and release it instead.
